name: 02138 · Cambridge, MA
findings: ZIP 02138 (Cambridge) has 417 nonprofit organizations. 155 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02138 (Cambridge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
